summary: This Form 6-K is a routine notification that Grupo Aeroportuario del Centro Norte (OMA), a Mexican airport operator listed on NASDAQ and BMV, has filed its annual report (Annual Report and Form 20-F) for the year ended December 31, 2025 with Mexican and U.S. regulators. No special-situation event—merger, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or management change—is announced. The filing merely confirms regulatory compliance, provides standard company description, and states where the reports are available. There are no deal terms, price, or premium. As a non-U.S. filer, this maps to a typical annual report filing without any special-situations classification.
